title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Japanese Derby…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Trainer. To the promised land.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Now… I wonder how much I'm gonna get booed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd goes wild the second Vodka walks out of the paddock. It's a mix of both admiration and disdain.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heheh, there it is… Exactly what I expected.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Half are kissin' me and half are dissin' me. But hey, they're all looking at me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That's right, Triple Crown tour fans. You'll be watchin' me today.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heheh. Tellin' me not to think too lightly of the Derby, huh? But here's the thing…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm not here to take it lightly! So don't you take me lightly either.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
choice_data_list: Right. You're not regretting this, are you?
Right. You're not regretting this, are you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Of course not! This is my starting grid. I've wanted to stand here ever since I was a kid. And now…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm stepping into unknown territory! Anyone who can overcome that and win is super cool.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm gonna do it, Trainer. I'm definitely gonna win.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I don't care how strong my opponents could be, I'm still gonna win and become Derby champion!
